waivers.reason: OR-8c is a maintenance rule about how the tooling behaves when an uncontrolled dependency is absent; it does not change what a deliverable must contain or how it must look, so the model-comparison board's staleness does not bear on this release. A board refresh is an operator task that drives the platform CLIs (a material dependency this very rule governs), owed at a big-version milestone and tracked separately.
